players.product: antibody discovery and multispecific T-cell engager platform

quarterly_data.signal: The T-cell engager platform combines diverse CD3 and co-stimulatory antibody panels, scalable protein engineering, functional assays, in-vivo translation and clinical-data feedback. Management said most enabling work is now established and more internal and partner programs can run without a large increase in platform resources.

Q2 revenue was about $4 million, R&D expense about $46 million and net loss about $55 million. Cash and marketable securities were $567 million; including roughly $110 million of available government funding, total available liquidity exceeded $675 million and management expects at least three years of pipeline funding.

contracts.signal: Vertex collaboration for multispecific T-cell engagers in autoimmune diseases and other conditions provides $28 million upfront, downstream milestone eligibility, tiered royalties and a potential option for AbCellera to conduct process development and clinical manufacturing.

Jazz collaboration includes three confirmed T-cell engager discovery programs with $84 million in near-term upfront payments, more than $2 billion potential downstream payments, and mid-single-digit to low-double-digit royalties. Two mutual options could expand the total potential deal value above $4 billion.
